entries.note: 作者用 Claude 写提示词、Seedance 2.5 生成；分镜提示词在作者回复里。
entries.prompt:
Rain-soaked cyberpunk skyscraper rooftop duel at night, premium semi-realistic 3D CGI, cinematic action film. Two adult women fight in one continuous space: a wet rooftop platform with a glass curtain wall on one side and a steel catwalk bridge on the other, neon billboards, metal railings, vents, hanging cables, puddles, bokeh city lights.

Fighter A, SILVER FLAME GUNNER: adult woman, long black hair whipping across her face, cold and menacing; torn grey-white upper jacket, flowing deep-red long skirt; dual pistols. Her power: silver-white liquid metal streams and platinum-white sparks only, liquid metal forming whips, shields and thrust jets around her, muzzle flashes of dense white-gold sparks, shell casings and spark trails on the ground. Gun-kata, slides, rolls, flips, aggressive pressure.

Fighter B, VIOLET CRYSTAL BLADE: adult woman, short black hair, sharp eyes, black cyber-armor bodysuit with mechanical limbs; one long slim katana plus several mechanical arms on her back, each tipped with a glowing blue-violet energy crystal blade. Her power: blue-violet crystal cutting trails and ionized violet sparks only. Precise, cold, ultra-fast multi-angle slashes, counterattacks, slicing bullets mid-air.

Their effects never mix: silver/white-gold for A, blue-violet for B.

0-5s: Fight starts on frame one. A slides in low firing both guns; B's crystal arms cross and slice the bullets into sparks. B zigzags low through the fire, slashes at A's face; A blocks with her left gun, metal sparks and violet shards burst. A back-arm blade grazes A's shoulder, tearing her jacket. A fires point-blank, B deflects with the blade but is knocked back half a step.
5-10s: A sweeps B's legs; B braces on mechanical arms and opens a ring of four crystal blades. A rolls behind her, shoots off one blade tip. B spins, top and bottom blades scissor in; A blocks with a liquid-metal arm shield and slides out across the wet floor in a spray of sparks and water, then fires into B's left mechanical arm joint: sparks and debris, the arm stutters. B lunges with a stab; A blocks with crossed guns and is pushed back, feet carving a long water trail.
10-15s: B leaps up onto steel beams, mechanical arms gripping like spider legs, dive-slashing from changing angles; A wall-runs firing, bullets sparking off beams. B's blade cuts A's thigh-side skirt. A rolls, fires both guns into the ground: a forward wave of silver flame blasts B back through a glass panel, glass shards and violet sparks exploding.
15-20s: B bursts out of the glass with a larger blade array, wave-like combo attacks; a back blade slashes A's left arm, armor cracks, liquid metal spills, A staggers. B goes for the neck; A jams the blade with her left gun and fires the right gun into B's chest armor, blasting her back so two mechanical arms snap a railing. A pulls all liquid metal into a spinning silver-flame vortex around herself.
20-25s: Both power up: a silver liquid-metal storm swirling around A; B's crystal blades spread into huge blue-violet wings. A dashes in zigzags firing; B's blades slice bullets and cut the silver streams, gunfire knocks blades aside, each impact sparks in its own colors. A fires at B's face, B dodges and slashes down, A lands a liquid-metal-coated kick to B's side; B spins away and her blades circle behind A.
25-30s: B fuses all blades into a spinning blue-violet drill and charges like an arrow; A stands firm and unleashes a forward torrent of silver flame and gunfire. The two forces collide in a storm of white-gold and violet sparks. A suddenly cuts her left gun, the blade slips past her side, and she blasts both guns into the blade-array core; the crystal blades shatter and fly apart while B's last slash tears A's right shoulder. A huge silver and violet shockwave flings railings, billboards and glass. The camera pulls high and dives back: A kneels on one side, shoulder wounded, silver flame still flowing; B crouches on the other, broken blades flickering.

In the rain and neon they lift their heads, lock eyes, and both rise to attack again; cut.

Camera: 24mm low tracking, 35mm close combat, 50mm weapon-contact close-ups, 18mm ultra-wide, fast orbits, over-the-shoulder, brief impact frames, high pull-out and dive-in. Fast but readable: always clear who attacks, who blocks, who is hit. Clear impact, cuts, damage and environmental destruction. Sound: gunfire, blade clashes, rain, shattering glass, no music vocals.

entries.prompt:
THE CINEMATIC STORY

30 seconds | 16:9 | Photorealistic Live Action | 12 Cinematic Shots
A quiet Thanksgiving afternoon in a suburban backyard. Golden maple leaves drift through warm sunlight as a little girl in an orange dress sits on a picnic blanket, happily playing with her toys.
Behind her, a towering Grim Reaper in a tattered black robe silently approaches, holding an ancient wooden scythe.
But someone notices.

A tiny fluffy calico kitten named Luna gently taps the Reaper's robe with her white paw.

She looks up with her beautiful blue eyes.

🐈 "Not her, old friend. She's only six."

The Reaper slowly lowers his hood, revealing a dark skull face.

Luna turns toward the little girl, then pushes a worn purple CAT LIVES card across the fallen leaves.

Eight of the nine lives are already crossed out.

🐈 "Take me instead."

The Reaper picks up the card, examining the final remaining life.

💀 "You'd trade for her... again?"

His gloved finger stops beneath the last uncrossed silhouette.

💀 "Oh... this is your last one."

Luna simply looks up and gives one tiny meow.

Moments later, she lies motionless beneath the golden tree.

The little girl crawls toward her, smiling at first, then realising something is wrong.

👧 "Luna? Luna... wake up."

She gently lifts the kitten into her arms.

"Please..."

Tears roll down her cheeks as she holds Luna against her chest.

CAMERA & STYLE:

ARRI Alexa 35, Cooke spherical lenses, intimate ground-level close-ups, macro paw details, dramatic low-angle compositions, shallow depth of field, natural golden-hour lighting, realistic fur movement, subtle film grain and hard cuts.

A gentle female internal voice for Luna, a deep compassionate male voice for Death, and natural child dialogue.

No background music. Only autumn wind, rustling leaves, soft footsteps, breathing and silence.
The cat never lip-syncs. No supernatural effects, exaggerated acting or CGI appearance.

Just one tiny act of love that changes everything. 🥺

entries.prompt:
10秒AI视频生成提示词

一、整体画面设定

生成一段约10秒的超写实电影级人物面部特写视频，采用16:9横屏构图，24FPS，画面具有真实电影摄影机拍摄的光学质感。整个视频只有一名年轻东亚女性作为主体，镜头始终集中在人物的脸部，不切换场景，不改变人物身份，不改变五官比例。

人物拥有自然清秀的东亚面部特征，黑色长发向后自然束起，部分发丝松散地垂落在脸颊两侧。一些非常细的黑色碎发从额头延伸至眉毛、眼角和面颊，形成自然、不规则的发丝遮挡。头发不能像经过精确梳理一样整齐，应保留真实人物的生活感。

人物面部呈现自然的椭圆形轮廓，眉毛纤细，眼睛清澈，虹膜颜色为深棕色，鼻梁自然，嘴唇呈现柔和的浅粉色。皮肤具有真实的毛孔、细小纹理、轻微肤色差异以及自然的皮肤反光。

人物不佩戴夸张饰品，不进行浓重化妆，不使用明显美颜效果。保留眼下、鼻翼、嘴角和面颊附近的自然皮肤细节。

画面采用极近距离人像特写，人物的额头、双眼、鼻梁、嘴唇和下颌占据主要画面。人物基本正对镜头，头部带有极轻微的角度偏转，肩颈区域只在画面下方少量出现。

背景为纯粹的深黑色，几乎没有可辨认的环境信息。人物从黑暗中自然浮现，形成强烈但克制的电影氛围。

二、摄影与灯光设计

使用电影级人像摄影布光，采用画面左侧偏上方的暖色柔光作为主要光源。

光线呈现淡淡的琥珀金色，照亮人物额头、鼻梁、左侧面颊、嘴唇和眼睛。鼻梁与颧骨具有自然的光影过渡，眼球表面存在微小而真实的光源反射。

面部另一侧逐渐沉入柔和阴影，但不能完全丢失皮肤细节。

整体采用低照度、高反差的电影摄影风格，暗部保持纯净，亮部保留自然的皮肤质感。

光线必须稳定，不允许在人物表情变化过程中出现不合理的明暗跳动。

模拟85mm电影人像镜头，浅景深，人物双眼始终处于清晰焦点。背景呈现自然的光学虚化，不能产生人工抠图边缘。

镜头保持固定，不推拉、不摇晃、不旋转，不进行突然变焦。整段视频依靠人物细微的面部动作传递情绪。

三、10秒完整表演时间轴

0—1秒：自然凝视与轻微嘟嘴

视频开始时，人物保持安静的状态，眼睛自然看向镜头附近。

嘴唇略微向前收拢，呈现轻微嘟嘴的状态，上下唇自然贴合，唇部肌肉只有轻微张力。

眼睛保持自然睁开，视线稳定，但不是完全僵硬地盯住镜头。

人物出现非常细微的眼球运动，像是在观察镜头前的人。

额头放松，眉毛保持自然状态。几缕黑色发丝垂落在面部，随着细微的头部动作产生轻微变化。

1—2.5秒：眼神变化与微笑萌生

人物的视线轻微移动，眼球先发生变化，随后眼睑产生自然调整。

嘴角开始缓慢向上移动，面颊肌肉轻微收缩，逐渐形成一个非常浅的微笑。

笑容并不是突然出现，而是从嘴角最细微的变化开始，逐渐扩散到面颊。

眼睛稍微眯起，上眼睑自然下降，眼尾出现细小的肌肉褶皱。

人物表现出一种不经意的温柔感，仿佛突然想起了一件令人愉快的事情。

2.5—4秒：浅笑与眼神偏移

人物的笑容稍微明显，但仍然保持克制。

嘴角继续轻微上扬，面颊自然隆起，鼻翼两侧产生极淡的笑纹。

随后人物的视线缓慢偏向一侧，眼球先移动，头部仍然基本保持稳定。

她似乎正在观察镜头旁边的某个人。

眼神带有一丝俏皮和温柔，嘴角保留浅浅的笑意。

在这一阶段，眼睛可以出现一次自然的短暂眨眼，闭合与重新睁开的过程符合真实人体生理规律。

4—5.5秒：微笑减弱，恢复平静

人物逐渐收回视线，重新看向镜头附近。

嘴角的笑意缓慢减弱，面颊肌肉逐渐放松。

上下嘴唇自然分开，呈现轻微的呼吸状态。

眼神从温柔转变为安静，眉毛保持自然，不出现突然的情绪变化。

人物的面部肌肉逐渐恢复到中性状态，形成从微笑到平静的自然过渡。

5.5—7秒：短暂惊讶与疑惑

人物突然注意到某件事情，表情出现细微变化。

双眼略微睁大，上眼睑轻轻抬起，眉毛向上移动，眉间产生轻微的紧张感。

眼球短暂向前集中，嘴唇自然分开，形成非常轻微的惊讶状态。

注意，这不是夸张的震惊，而是生活中突然听到某句话、意识到某件事情时出现的真实反应。

随后眉毛开始向中央靠拢，眉间出现浅浅的皱纹，眼神中加入一点疑惑。

嘴唇保持微张，下颌稍微放松。

7—8.5秒：疑惑逐渐转为沉思

人物的视线开始缓慢向下移动。

眼球首先向下转动，随后上眼睑自然跟随下降。

眉头仍然保留少量紧张感，但整体开始放松。

嘴唇慢慢闭合，嘴角不再保持笑意，唇部肌肉呈现轻微收敛状态。

面部表情从疑惑逐渐过渡为安静的思考。

人物不做夸张动作，只通过眼神、眉毛和嘴唇的微小变化表现心理活动。

8.5—10秒：低头与安静收尾

人物的视线继续向下，头部轻轻低垂。

下巴产生非常轻微的向内收缩，颈部保持自然状态。

眼睛半闭，随后出现短暂的自然眨眼。

嘴唇轻轻抿合，面颊肌肉完全放松，脸上不再保留明显笑容。

几缕散落在脸颊上的发丝随着头部运动发生细微位移。

最后人物保持低头沉思的状态，情绪克制、安静，带有一点淡淡的失落感。

画面在人物低头的瞬间自然结束，不要突然抬头，不要重新微笑，不要出现突兀的表情变化。

四、面部微表情真实性要求

整段视频的核心是极其细腻的人类面部肌肉运动。

所有表情都必须通过真实的局部肌肉变化完成，而不是让整张脸同步变形。

眼睛必须保持真实的眼球结构，眼球移动时虹膜、瞳孔和眼睑之间具有正确的相对关系。

人物眨眼时，上下眼睑自然闭合，睫毛随着眼皮运动，闭眼后再自然睁开。

微笑时，嘴角首先发生轻微移动，随后面颊隆起，最后影响眼角肌肉。

疑惑时，眉间肌肉逐渐收缩，额头形成自然的浅纹，不能出现夸张的深皱纹。

嘴唇具有真实的软组织弹性，张开、闭合、抿唇和放松的过程必须连贯。

面部不能出现塑料般的整体平滑移动，也不能出现表情突然跳帧。

五、头发、皮肤与环境细节

头发必须保留真实的单根发丝质感，额头和面颊附近的碎发保持自然随机分布。

部分发丝可以轻轻贴在面颊上，随着头部动作产生微小摆动，但不能突然消失、变长或改变位置。

皮肤必须呈现真实的毛孔、细微纹理和自然的油脂反射。

嘴唇具有真实的湿润感，但不能过度高光。

眼球具有自然的湿润反射，眼白不能过度洁白，虹膜细节清晰自然。

整个画面不添加额外人物、道具、背景装饰或环境变化。

六、最终视觉质量

整体风格参考高品质电影摄影中的人物情绪特写。

采用自然的电影色彩科学，暖色肤色与深黑背景形成对比。

保留适量胶片颗粒，避免数码锐化过度，暗部不出现明显噪点。

画面必须保持人物身份一致、五官稳定、眼神真实、面部动作连续。

最终呈现效果应当像专业电影摄影师使用高端摄影机拍摄的一段真实人物面部表演测试。

七、负面提示词

禁止人物身份变化、脸型漂移、五官错位、眼睛变形、瞳孔异常、虹膜闪烁、嘴唇扭曲、牙齿突然出现、面部肌肉抽搐、皮肤闪烁。

禁止机械眨眼、僵硬假笑、突然大笑、夸张惊讶、过度悲伤、突然哭泣、无意义张嘴、快速转头、突然低头。

禁止塑料皮肤、蜡像质感、过度磨皮、过度美颜、虚假毛孔、面部过度锐化、过曝、HDR效果。

禁止发丝穿透皮肤、发丝闪烁、头发突然变化、耳朵变形、背景闪烁、画面抖动、镜头跳切、景别变化、人物比例变化。

无对白、无字幕、无水印、无额外人物、无背景音乐强制要求。

最终目标：在10秒内完整呈现人物从轻微嘟嘴、自然微笑、眼神偏移、短暂惊讶到低头沉思的连续变化。让每一次眼神移动、嘴角牵引、眉毛变化和眨眼都具有真实的人类生理特征，达到电影级超写实人物微表情效果。

entries.title: 草原动物 3D 喜剧短片
entries.note: 多段分镜提示词，在作者回复里。
entries.prompt:
Style + characters :

Premium 3D animated comedy short, feature-film cartoon quality, soft global illumination, rich saturated colors, expressive squash-and-stretch animation, 16:9, 24fps, cinematic depth of field. Setting: an African savanna with tall green grass, a red dirt road, acacia trees and a big blue sky with soft clouds; later scenes at golden sunset with orange-pink skies and golden grass. GUABU: a small chubby bright lime-green frog with huge round eyes, a wide goofy grin and a big laugh; he rides on animals' backs and carries an oversized cartoon toy rifle. THE HYENA: a spotted brown hyena with yellow eyes, a cocky smirk and a tuft of hair tied up in a small ponytail with a red hair tie; he rides on top of fluffy spotted round fur-balls that roll like wheels. THE HYENA GANG: many identical spotted hyenas, each with the same red-tied ponytail, goofy toothy grins. WARTHOG: big hairy brown warthog with tusks and a thin tail. BUFFALO: huge calm black cape buffalo with curved horns.

Sound (every clip): loud, crisp, full-range cartoon sound design, no music bed, no dialogue (only grunts, laughs, screams). Punchy cartoon whooshes, boings, rubbery squeaks, big comic fart blasts with deep sub-bass, dust explosions, running hoof thunder, savanna wind and birds in the background.

CLIP 1 (0–10s): The chili

Shot 1: close-up, the hyena riding his rolling fur-balls down the dirt road, aiming a cartoon gun with a bright orange muzzle flash, smirking. Shot 2: a bright red chili pepper flies out of frame in slow motion, spinning through the air against the blurred green savanna. Shot 3: tracking side shot of the chili sailing across the blue sky. Shot 4: extreme close-up of the warthog's big hairy rear end, the chili flies in and sticks right in his butt. Shot 5: the warthog freezes, his tail shoots straight up, and a puff of dust blasts out behind him.
Sound: a snappy gunshot pop, a whistling slow-motion whoosh as the chili spins, a comic "thwip" when it lands, a squeaky surprised squeal, a rising whistle as the tail stiffens, then a dust-puff "poof".

CLIP 2 (10–22s): The chase

Shot 1: wide side shot, the warthog launches off like a rocket down the red dirt road, leaving a long trail of dust, Guabu the frog bouncing on his back clutching his toy rifle and laughing. Shot 2: low tracking shot from the side as the warthog gallops at full speed, legs a blur. Shot 3: front shot, the warthog charges straight at the camera with Guabu on top, the hyena chasing behind on his rolling fur-balls, dust everywhere. Shot 4: the chili flies back out of the warthog and spins high into the sky.
Sound: a cartoon rocket launch "zoom", rapid thumping hooves, Guabu's high-pitched giggle, rolling fur-ball "thrum-thrum", wind rush, a long descending whistle as the chili flies.

CLIP 3 (22–30s): Hair on fire

Shot 1: the chili drops right onto the hyena's ponytail. Shot 2: close-up from behind, the ponytail bursts into a big orange flame. Shot 3: the hyena stands up on his fur-balls screaming, eyes wide, slapping his flaming head. Shot 4: Guabu on the warthog's back turns around and bursts out laughing while the burning hyena shrinks in the distance. Shot 5: close-up of Guabu laughing with his mouth wide open, holding his toy rifle.
Sound: a "fwoosh" ignition, crackling fire, a long comic scream, frantic slapping, Guabu's big belly laugh, dust and hooves fading away.

CLIP 4 (30–44s): The gang shows up

Shot 1: the hyena's fur-balls roll to a stop and three hyenas pop out of them, glaring. Shot 2: low shot, three angry hyenas stomp forward on the dirt road. Shot 3: golden sunset, Guabu now sits calmly on the back of a huge black buffalo grazing in the golden grass. Shot 4: a line of four hyenas with red-tied ponytails slowly rises into frame, grinning wickedly. Shot 5: close-up, the hyenas lean in and laugh menacingly at the camera.
Sound: rubbery unrolling "boing-boing", angry growls, a scene-change whoosh into peaceful sunset ambience (soft wind, birds, the buffalo chewing grass), then sneaky tiptoe plucks and evil cackling.

CLIP 5 (44–60s): The buffalo blast

Shot 1: over-the-shoulder from behind Guabu on the buffalo's back, the hyena gang charges in the distance. Shot 2: the buffalo lifts its tail and releases a giant fart that becomes a huge circular dust shockwave, blasting the hyenas into the air. Shot 3: hyenas spin through the dust cloud in slow motion. Shot 4: wide golden-hour shot, hyenas lying flat on their backs in the grass, dizzy. Shot 5: the dazed hyenas slowly sit up, coughing, more hyenas arrive and the gang regroups into a big line.
Sound: galloping hyena paws and battle yelps, a massive deep fart boom with a sub-bass shockwave and dust roar, slow-motion whooshes and yelps, comic thuds as they land, dizzy cartoon birds tweeting, coughs, grumbles.

CLIP 6 (60–81s): The flying circle

Shot 1: a big gang of hyenas leaps toward the camera together. Shot 2: the hyenas grab paws mid-air and form a giant spinning circle in the blue sky. Shot 3: wide shot, the hyena ring floats over the savanna. Shot 4: low front shot, Guabu sits on top of the buffalo's head laughing hysterically while the hyena ring spins above them. Shot 5: wide shot, the buffalo calmly lets out one more enormous fart, a white blast shoots straight up and launches the hyena ring high into the sky.
Sound: a big group leap whoosh, a spinning carousel whirr, silly hyena giggles, Guabu's loud laughing, a deep rumbling build-up, then a giant fart cannon blast with a sub-bass boom, whistles fading upward and a final comic "ding".

Absolutely! It's amazing to see how much AI tools are evolving. The possibilities are endless!

Create a high-quality 75-second vertical cinematic video in 9:16 format, with realistic visuals, smooth camera movements, beautiful lighting, and professional film-style editing.

Scene 1 (0–10 seconds): Desert Road Trip
A young Asian couple travels together in a stylish vintage car through a beautiful desert highway during golden hour. Show cinematic close-ups of their faces in the rear-view mirror, hands on the steering wheel, and wide shots of the endless road.

Scene 2 (10–20 seconds): Romantic Moments
Show the couple laughing, smiling, and enjoying their journey. Capture emotional close-ups, beautiful sunlight reflecting through the car windows, and a cinematic close-up of the car's spinning wheels.

Scene 3 (20–30 seconds): Neon City
The couple arrives at a futuristic neon-lit city at night. Show them sitting together inside a beautiful retro diner surrounded by glowing pink, blue, and purple lights. Use cinematic reflections and smooth camera transitions.

Scene 4 (30–40 seconds): AI Editing Tutorial
Transition into a professional computer-screen recording showing an AI video editing workspace. Display a storyboard with multiple cinematic video shots and a timeline. Add a clean instructional title: "Step 1: Analyze the Video".

Scene 5 (40–50 seconds): Writing the Prompt
Show an AI chat interface where a detailed cinematic video prompt is being written. Add the title: "Step 2: Write the Prompt". Highlight the prompt area with a subtle glowing border.

Scene 6 (50–60 seconds): Generate Video
Show an AI video generation interface with model selection, settings, and a glowing Generate button. Display the title: "Step 3: Generate Your Video".

Scene 7 (60–75 seconds): Final Cinematic Result
Return to the beautiful Asian couple walking together in a futuristic neon city. Show them smiling, enjoying the night, and sharing a romantic moment. Finish with a cinematic wide shot and a smooth fade to black.

Visual Style: Ultra-realistic cinematic photography, 4K appearance, beautiful color grading, golden-hour lighting, neon reflections, smooth transitions, realistic facial expressions, professional commercial editing, and engaging storytelling.
